```yaml
name: Docs Preview Deploy

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Docs Preview Build"]
    types:
      - completed

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: >-
      github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    steps:
      - name: Download artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-preview
          path: docs-build
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}

      - name: Download metadata
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-preview-metadata
          path: metadata
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}

      - name: Read metadata
        id: meta
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=$(cat metadata/pr_number.txt)
          BRANCH_NAME=$(cat metadata/branch_name.txt)
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "branch_name=$BRANCH_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./docs-build
          destination_dir: previews/${{ steps.meta.outputs.pr_number }}
          keep_files: true
          force_orphan: false
          commit_message: "Deploy docs preview for PR #${{ steps.meta.outputs.pr_number }} (${{ steps.meta.outputs.branch_name }})"

  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: >-
      github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].state == 'closed'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout gh-pages
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: gh-pages
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Download metadata
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-preview-metadata
          path: metadata
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}

      - name: Read metadata
        id: meta
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=$(cat metadata/pr_number.txt)
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Remove preview directory
        run: |
          rm -rf previews/${{ steps.meta.outputs.pr_number }}

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Remove docs preview for PR #${{ steps.meta.outputs.pr_number }}"
          git push origin gh-pages
```
